item.title: The Notebook
item.description:
Wednesday, July 22, 2026 at 2:15 PM

By midweek, we could all use a little pick-me-up. Wine Wednesdays are your perfect excuse to press pause on your problems and pour a glass instead. Each ticket includes a complimentary glass of house wine—so you can toast being halfway to the weekend with friends (or a very good date). Then sink into our ultra-comfortable seats and enjoy a fan-favorite film under the stars. Midweek meltdown? Best handled with a movie. 🍷🎬

item.title: Grease
item.description:
Sunday, August 2, 2026 at 2:15 PM

Tell me about it- Stud! Join us for a dragtacular event that's way more electrifying than a high school pep rally! Before we queue up this campy classic, we've got a lineup of queens serving looks, lipsyncs, and shade that would make Rizzo proud. Expect to be singing, dancing, and losing your voice by the end of the night! Timeline of Events: 🕕 6:30–7:15 PM – Doors Open 💋 7:15- 8:00 PM – Drag Performances 🎬 8:00- 9:45 PM – GREASE Screening Don't be a beauty school drop out! Grab your tickets now. Please bring $1 bills for tips- we do not carry cash on site Tickets are non-refundable or transferable. If the event is canceled or rescheduled due to inclement weather, guests will be offered a transfer credit that can be applied towards a future screening. We try our best to reschedule all events and guests can transfer directly to that date.

item.title: La La Land
item.description:
Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 2:15 PM

It's been a decade since La La Land first danced across the screen and stole our hearts. To celebrate the 10th anniversary, we're bringing Mia and Sebastian's technicolor world back to the rooftop. Whether you're a jazz purist or just a hopeless romantic, join us under the stars to toast to the fools who dream!
